question.text: OTP verification is generally required for which off-market transfers (subject to specified regulatory/government direction waivers)?

answer.text: All off-market transfers — both within the depository and inter-depository

explanation.text: The Logic: OTP consent is generally required for all off-market transfers, both within a depository and inter-depository, subject to specified waivers — notably SEBI's waiver of OTP for the off-market transfer reason code 'Implementation of Government / Regulatory Direction / Orders'. The Trap: 'Only inter-depository' is too narrow — the OTP requirement applies broadly across off-market transfer types. Note: The OTP requirement is broad but not absolute; specific waivers exist as described in the Series VI workbook.
